notes:
Diastema 0.32.0-beta.4 (beta)

This beta is everything Diastema has, in one build: the stable version (through 0.29.10) and every beta since. An office that switches from stable to beta gets it. With Open Dental, the office works the way it does today.

Changed since 0.32.0-beta.3

- Procedure forms: a new office's starter Implants code group is implant surgery only (D6010-D6013, D6040, D6050, D6100-D6107), so implant crowns and abutments no longer get the implant surgery consent and pre-op pages. Implant crowns and abutments (D6051-D6077) are a starter code group of their own, on no row until the office picks forms for it.
- An office that already saved its code groups keeps them as they are. To make the same change, open Settings → Patient forms → Procedure forms → Code groups → Implants and set it to D6010-D6013, D6040, D6050, D6100-D6107.

Before you switch

Coming from 0.32.0-beta.1, beta.2 or beta.3: nothing to do; there is no database update in this beta.

Coming from stable: see the 0.32.0-beta.2 notes. A database update runs once at the first start and saves a copy of the database first (in the data folder's backups, named "before-v49"). Keep that copy.
